problem_reproduced: A synthetic row-level reversal changed four earnings in one order instead of only the selected earning.
changes: Selected reversals now bind the earning ID as well as the order. Whole-order return processing retains its existing scope, proportional calculations and replay behavior.
Reversal audit metadata identifies the selected earning; reversals and their audit remain atomic. Paid source entries and historical amounts are preserved.
Legacy staff rule changes use a canonical product/recipient/type/channel transaction lock, skip identical replays, refuse ambiguous active duplicates, and audit edits and deactivation atomically.

Commission mutations remain director-only even for a manager with every commission grant. Identifier pipes and bounded notes, payment references, recipient kinds and rule amounts reject invalid input before financial handlers.
The legacy personnel screen has in-panel record-specific confirmations, a synchronous action lock, refresh/retry controls, strict read validation and disabled writes until current data is verified.
Financial write errors trigger one read, never an automatic write replay. Confirmed saves remain distinguishable from failed subsequent reads.
Payment wording describes recording a completed payment rather than sending a bank transfer; account currency is checked. Selected products remain visible when search text changes.

verification.http_and_unit: 199 tests across identifier HTTP, staff security and legacy commission suites passed. Real Nest guards/pipes/router handling with synthetic identities; no TCP listener or real writes.
verification.sql: verify-selected-commission-reversal.cjs passed selected recipient/product isolation, replay, whole-order returns, paid-history preservation, audit rollback, rule lifecycle and immutable earnings. Staff-pool and dealer-wallet SQL regression checks also passed.
verification.handlers: verify-legacy-commission-workspace.cjs passed duplicate-click prevention, failed reads, uncertain write outcomes, currency checks, stale/unmounted responses and own-only controls.
verification.markup: verify-legacy-commission-view.cjs passed boxed inline confirmations, disabled controls, honest unavailable states and retained selections. Browser layout remains unverified.
verification.builds: commission-final-api-build-20261122-evening.log and manager-evening-final-admin-build-20261122.log passed. Later audit-only UI changes are covered by the cumulative final build.

limits: No separate production PostgreSQL writers were available for a lock-concurrency stress test.
Live financial records, bank transfers and historical earnings were not modified.
